question: Calculate the total income from Meat Lovers pizzas priced at $12 and Vegetarian pizzas at $10. Include any extra toppings charged at $1 each. Ensure that canceled orders are filtered out. How much money has Pizza Runner earned in total?
sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN pizza_id = 1 THEN 12.0
            WHEN pizza_id = 2 THEN 10.0
        END + 
        COALESCE(
            CASE 
                WHEN extras IS NULL OR extras = '' THEN 0
                ELSE (LENGTH(extras) - LENGTH(REPLACE(extras, ',', '')) + 1)
            END,
            0
        )
    ) as total_income
FROM pizza_customer_orders pco
LEFT JOIN pizza_runner_orders prr ON pco.order_id = prr.order_id
WHERE COALESCE(prr.cancellation, '') = ''
